//: The stop and refusal catalogue. RaftKit skills emit fixed lines but there is no machine-readable stop signal, so detection matches the strings that exist. Every pattern is transcribed from the skill that owns it — `source` names that file. Order matters: the first match wins, so specific rules precede `generic-cant`. When a skill changes an owned string, update it here in the same commit; tests/structure.test.sh checks that every `source` exists.

refusals.example: **STOP** — approve to push, edit to change, or decline.
Missing: superpowers. Install it with: claude plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official
nothing to raise — branch has no commits beyond target
raftkit-core is required — install it from the raftkit marketplace.
Can't read the live template — check your Asana connector, then retry.
Can't read the story — check your Asana connector, then retry.
Can't retest — "Fixed in build ___" is empty.
Can't start the fix — the bug task is missing Steps to Reproduce.
Can't reproduce in the stated environment.

refusals.source: shared convention; catch-all, must stay last
refusals.example: Can't proceed — some new refusal a skill added later.
